email.description: Email address where notifications should be sent

notify_new.description: Set to "1" to enable notifications for newly available packages

notify_security.description: Set to "1" to enable notifications only for security updates

dry_run.description: Set to "1" to perform a dry-run (no actual upgrades)

show_held.description: Set to "1" to include held/outdated packages not upgradeable

show_downgrades.description: Set to "1" to include packages that would be downgraded

silent.description: Set to "1" to suppress output for unchanged packages

debug.description: Set to "1" to enable debug mode

syslog.description: Set to "1" to log to syslog

subject_prefix.description: Custom prefix for notification email subject
